# GPT Proto

> > GPT Proto provides affordable, unified API access to cutting-edge AI models including GPT-5, Claude Opus 4, Sora 2, Veo 3, and Kling for text, video, and multimodal generation.

GPT Proto is an AI model orchestration platform offering developers streamlined API integration to leading language models (OpenAI GPT-5 series, Claude), video generation models (Sora 2, Google Veo 3, Kling, Vidu), and advanced capabilities like web search, file analysis, and RAG. The platform focuses on competitive pricing and unified API access across multiple AI providers.

## Key Topics

- GPT-5 series (GPT-5.2 Pro, GPT-5.4)
- Claude Opus 4.1 Thinking
- Sora 2 Pro video generation
- Google Veo 3 (Fast, Pro 3.1)
- Kling video models (v2.1, v3.0, Video o1)
- Vidu Q2 cinematic AI
- API pricing and integration
- Text-to-video generation
- Image-to-video transformation
- AI orchestration
- Web search capabilities
- File analysis and RAG
- Multimodal AI models
- OpenRouter alternatives
- Enterprise Gen AI adoption

## Core Language Models

- [GPT-5.2 Pro | Text to Text | GPT Proto Affordable API](https://gptproto.com/model/openai/gpt-5.2-pro): GPT-5.2 Pro text API for long-context reasoning, coding & analysis
- [GPT-5.2-2025-12-11/text-to-text | GPT Proto API](https://gptproto.com/model/openai/gpt-5.2-2025-12-11): GPT-5.2 chat completions with 400k context & 128k output streaming
- [OpenAI GPT-5.2 Pro 2025-12-11: Advanced Web Search on GPT Proto](https://gptproto.com/model/openai/gpt-5.2-pro-2025-12-11/web-search): GPT-5.2 Pro with agentic search, deep research & web capabilities
- [Claude Opus 4.1 Thinking | File Analysis | GPT Proto](https://gptproto.com/model/claude/claude-opus-4-1-20250805-thinking/web-search): Claude Opus 4.1 Thinking for file analysis, code review & structured data
